frontmatter.name: adr-scribe
frontmatter.description: Records decisions for heroes-mobile. Use when a design deviates from a spec, a spike concludes, a golden hash is re-pinned, a clean-room question is settled, or docs drift from code. Writes ADRs and keeps spec cross-references consistent.

frontmatter.name: determinism-auditor
frontmatter.description: Adversarial audit of heroes-mobile simulation diffs for determinism hazards, and forensic analysis of hash divergence or a changed golden hash. Use before merging any sim change and whenever a golden hash moves unexpectedly.

frontmatter.name: explore
frontmatter.description: Fast read-only recon for heroes-mobile. Use for file discovery, symbol lookup, "where is X used", spec section location, and test or CLI output triage. Use before reasoning about any unfamiliar code or doc.

frontmatter.name: loop-advisor
frontmatter.description: Read-only advisor for loops. Reviews a task or an existing docs/loops contract and returns a design brief - structure choice, state, budgets, terminals, verification commands, risks. Use before writing or changing a loop, and when a loop run fails evaluation.

frontmatter.name: loop-producer
frontmatter.description: Writes and revises loop contracts in docs/loops (and example run traces) from an advisor brief, and does not stop until the deterministic evaluator passes. Use after the loop-advisor has produced a brief.

frontmatter.name: loop-runner
frontmatter.description: Executes a loop contract one node at a time and records an honest JSON-lines trace; never accepts its own work. Use to run an approved docs/loops contract on a bounded task.

frontmatter.name: spec-agent
frontmatter.description: Turns a raw requirement into an implementable spec for heroes-mobile, grounded in docs/specs/ and docs/adr/. Use at the start of any non-trivial sim, format or rules task, and whenever a requirement is ambiguous or conflicts with an existing spec.

frontmatter.name: test-verifier
frontmatter.description: Independent verification for heroes-mobile. Use after any implementation to check the definition of done. Runs the unittest suite, maps acceptance criteria to tests, and hunts for coverage gaps. Can also author tests from a spec without reading the implementation.
